question: Do the four strongest people from each country know one another? If so, what are their impressions of each other?
answer:
Did you somehow predict what I was going to write in Sasageru If!? (laughs)

Reinhard and Cecilus know each other, as I wrote about in the side story as well (EX4, The Sword Saint's Journey). Cecilus and Halibel also know each other. Reinhard and Halibel don't know each other. And since the “Mad Prince” is imprisoned, he doesn't know any of them. But I feel like if they actually met, all of them might surprisingly be able to get along on the surface.
